info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of International Business

description.describe_ch: 本課程的目的，在協助碩士班學生培養對於國際企業進行策略分析、規劃、執行與控管的基本認知。以幫助學生了解下列的主題：策略管理的基本概念、策略分析的模式與工具、策略執行與控制的模式與工具與企業策略規劃的制度與流程。而透過本土與國外實際國際企業個案教學的運作，亦可教導碩士班學生培養相關的思考邏輯與技巧。
description.describe_eh: The purpose of this course is try to help students to generate the fundamental knowledge of the analyzing, planning, executing and controlling of international business strategies. Main ideas should be explored but not limited to include as the concepts of strategies, the modes and tools of strategic analysis, the strategic planning system of an enterprise and so on. By applying case teaching methods, MBA students can also generate more analytical and thinking skills.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Classroom Etiquette

Embracing Diversity and Inclusion
All course activities will transpire within a welcoming ambiance of engagement and interaction among classmates, fostering a climate of mutual respect and genuine appreciation for each student's unique experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. This encompasses diverse educational systems, varied enrollment and learning cultures, gender considerations, and more. It is imperative that you consistently uphold the utmost academic standards throughout this course and treat your peers with unwavering dignity and respect.

Classroom Conduct
Conduct within the classroom should invariably embody punctuality, professionalism, thorough preparation, and courtesy. A shared sense of dignity and respect must prevail among students, instructors, and other presenters to facilitate effective learning. To cultivate an environment conducive to learning, it is hoped that each individual will adhere to the following guidelines, abiding by classroom behavior regulations and fostering a culture of politeness.

Students are expected to attend classes promptly. Should your schedule hinder timely arrival, reconsidering enrollment in the course is advised. Barring illness or emergencies, arriving in the classroom before the commencement of class and assuming your seat is requisite. For instances where an early departure is necessary, advance notice is appreciated.

All students within the classroom should consistently demonstrate mutual respect and comport themselves with rationality, accountability, and courteousness.

During class, kindly refrain from speaking, reading, dozing off, or participating in unrelated activities, except for group discussions. Superfluous side conversations should be minimized. If seated next to an individual who might lead you into conversational temptation, kindly relocate to another seat to prevent succumbing to distraction.

When a fellow classmate is presenting or posing a question, extend your undivided attention. While presenting, address your group or the entire class audibly and distinctly to ensure comprehensive audibility.

Using laptops or tablets for note-taking during class is permissible; otherwise, such devices should be stowed away.

Prioritize the deactivation and silencing of mobile phones, PDAs, and other mobile devices to ensure an interruption-free environment during class.

The use of headphones should be abstained from during class.

Appropriate attire that avoids undue exposure is encouraged.

It is envisaged that the course rules will be conveyed with professional articulation, maintaining the highest standards and fostering mutual respect within diverse and inclusive discourse.

Instructors are authorized to provide guidance on students' expected conduct during the learning process. Students are expected to uphold their responsibilities accordingly.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
During project presentations, you should observe and evaluate your classmates' learning tasks. It's important to foster collaboration among peers in order to successfully accomplish written reports or special projects. Creating study or reading groups can prove to be a highly effective learning approach. However, when composing articles or papers, it's essential that the language used is your own.
It is imperative that you conscientiously adhere to the established rules for citing the sources of words and ideas. If you incorporate phrases, quotes, or adopt terminology and concepts from other authors, proper credit must be given to the origins of these terms or ideas, and you must appropriately reference these sources within your report. This involves including the author's name and, at the conclusion of the sentence, specifying the page numbers when citing the source materials.
